dispositions.topic_text: Manifest representation of withdrawal’s absent idempotency key and refusal-on-replay behavior
dispositions.reason: State 6 and 7 already represent it: the contract withdraw_pointer(transaction, pointer_id, principal, instant) takes no request id, and its notes refuse a repeat with the WITHDRAWN member of models.RefusalKind, changing nothing (80_notes.md withdraw_pointer VALIDATION_ERROR and TEST_EVIDENCE).

dispositions.topic_text: Subclass recognition and whether subclass-declared fields are included
dispositions.reason: No subclass of a model of models can exist in Registry: SPEC_STANDARD 12 forbids model inheritance, the models emitter writes every model class, and no module declares a class deriving from one; a model is a value of one of them, as State 3 and State 5 say.
